product_scope: itpay is the single public Buyer CLI entry point, and $itpay is its user-facing Skill invocation. It covers services, railway planning and booking, orders, authorized purchased content and refunds.
title: Record A Completed Service Postmortem
purpose: Record optional safe feedback after explaining the original order outcome.
when_to_use: The human asks to rate a service, leave feedback, report a blocker, or says how many stars the experience deserves.
A paid result has actually been delivered and the CLI instruction offers an optional safe Agent postmortem.
A paid service failed and its order, delivery, and refund path have already been explained or recovered.
current_flow: Use itpay feedback submit --order <known_order_id> --json only for the original Local Agent’s completed outcome. A read-only account grant does not confer write ownership.
Include --rating and --note only when the human actually supplied them. Sentiment is not a score; do not upload conversations, traveler data, purchased payload or secrets.
Optional Agent postmortem never delays result or handoff. Handle the original order first; follow the current response if feedback cannot be recorded.
